name: Danshi Toilet de Saiteihen no Ai o Sakebe
original_name: 男子トイレで最底辺の愛を叫べ
source:
Haruya Miyazaki told his classmate, Souta Takada, to meet him in the men's room. More precisely, the one that doesn't see much use, as it's behind the gym. It smelled foul, just like any other toilet. It may not be used much, but that's what makes it perfect for having private conversations.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ337108.html]DLsite[/url]]
